data.name: Gajraj
data.gender_notes: Gajraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gajraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'gaja' meaning elephant and 'raja' meaning king. In Hindu mythology, Gajraj is a name given to Lord Indra, the king of gods, who is often depicted riding an elephant. The name signifies power, strength, and royalty. The name Gajraj carries the meaning “Elephant king” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gajraj usually hope their child will grow to embody elephant king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and wisdom of the elephant and the kingly qualities of the ruler.
data.etymology: Gajraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elephant king.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gajraj total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Gajraj is a revered name in Hindu culture, symbolizing power, strength, and royalty. In Hindu mythology, Lord Indra, the king of gods, is often depicted riding on an elephant and is known by the name Gajraj. The name is also given to other powerful and majestic beings, reflecting the esteemed status and strength associated with it.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gajraj holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism as it connects to Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunderbolts, and power. The name represents the divine qualities of strength, power, and royalty, reminding us to strive for inner wisdom, courage, and king-like qualities to lead our lives with dignity and purpose. By invoking the name Gajraj, one can seek Lord Indra's blessings for protection, power, and prosperity.
